logo.name: Logo & favicon
logo.logo_info: SVG or PNG with transparent background. Without a logo the shop name is shown as a text logo.

colors.name: Colors
colors.surface_info: Used for cards, product images and highlights.
colors.background_gradient_info: Optional. Replaces the background color – check text contrast.
colors.contrast_info: Keep at least 4.5:1 contrast against the background for accessibility.
colors.accent_info: Used for links and focus outlines. At least 4.5:1 contrast against the background.
colors.border_strong_info: At least 3:1 contrast against the background.

typography.name: Typography
typography.info: Fonts are served from the Shopify CDN. Every additional font weight adds loading time.
typography.body_font_info: Recommended: Inter 400. The 600 weight is added automatically for emphasis.

layout.name: Layout
layout.animations_info: Subtle reveal on scroll. Automatically disabled when visitors prefer reduced motion.

shipping.name: Shipping
shipping.info: These values only control what the theme displays. Actual shipping rates are set in Settings → Shipping and delivery – keep both in sync.
shipping.info_url_info: Linked from "plus shipping", e.g. /pages/versand-zahlung. Leave empty to link the shipping policy.

header.name: Header
header.menu_info: Links to collections without products are hidden automatically.

footer.name: Footer
footer.legal_menu_info: Leave empty to link the store policies from Settings → Policies automatically.

menu.name: Menu column
menu.heading: Heading
menu.heading_info: Leave empty to use the menu name.

main_collection.name: Collection
main_collection.show_description_info: Text from the collection's description field in the admin.
main_collection.enable_filtering_info: Set up filters in the "Shopify Search & Discovery" app. Without filters no filter button is shown.
main_collection.fallback_collection_info: Linked when a collection has no products yet.
main_collection.seo_text_info: Maintain per collection via the metafield custom.seo_text (rich text). This default applies to all collections without the metafield – leave empty to avoid duplicate content.

announcement_bar.name: Announcement bar
announcement_bar.text_info: Leave empty for the automatic free shipping text from Theme settings → Shipping.

hero.name: Hero
hero.image_info: Main image and LCP element: loaded immediately with high priority. Recommended: 2560 × 1440 px, dark interior shot.
hero.video_info: Plays muted and only starts when visitors have not requested reduced motion. The image stays visible as poster.
hero.overlay_info: Keeps text readable on the image.
hero.heading: Heading (H1)
hero.heading_info: The only H1 on the home page – important for SEO.
hero.highlight_product_info: Optional: small product card in the hero.

shipping.name: Free shipping (auto)
shipping.info: The amount comes from Theme settings → Shipping.

featured_collection.name: Featured collection
featured_collection.show_quick_add_info: Products without variants get "Add to cart", others "Choose options".

how_it_works.name: How it works
how_it_works.button_link_info: Recommended: the installation & compatibility page. Without a link no button is shown.

social_proof.name: Social proof
social_proof.info: Only use genuine reviews and press mentions. The section appears once blocks exist.
social_proof.disclosure_info: Required under § 5b (3) UWG: whether and how reviews are verified.

logo.name: Press logo
logo.name_info: Used as alt text, or shown as text without a logo.

collection_list.name: Collection teaser
collection_list.show_placeholders_info: Tiles of empty collections are hidden. Only when all are empty, marked placeholders appear.

collection.name: Collection
collection.title_info: Leave empty to use the collection title.
collection.image_info: Leave empty to use the collection image.

newsletter.name: Newsletter
newsletter.info: Uses the Shopify customer form. Recommended: enable double opt-in in the admin.

common.image_mobile_info: Separate image for smartphones, ideally portrait 4:5.
common.heading: Heading
common.title: Title
common.show_placeholders: Show placeholders while there are no products
common.show_placeholders_info: Clearly marked as placeholders. Disappear automatically once products exist. When off, the section is hidden instead.
